title: Activity 1.1: Design Blueprints
text:
Scenario
We are interested in examining the effect of dietary protein on growth in Standard Bronze farm-raised turkeys. There are 24 turkeys available for the study.
The turkeys are housed 3 to a pen, and each pen has a single feed trough, meaning all turkeys within a pen receive the same diet.
Two diets are studied:

Low-protein diet: 15% protein

High-protein diet: 30% protein

Diets are assigned at random to pens, with 4 pens receiving each diet (8 pens total).
The turkeys are fed their assigned diet for 6 weeks. The primary outcome measured on each turkey is average daily weight gain (ADG), in lbs/day.

Create a plot of pen-level ADG on the y-axis and Diet on the x-axis (Hint: each diet should have 4 dots). Don’t forget to make sure your plot has clear axis labels and a title!

title: Activity 1.1: Design Blueprints
text:
5. Comparing Analyses
Now consider a two-sample t-test comparing the low-protein and high-protein diets.

Pen-level analysis

Using turkey_pen_data.csv, conduct a two-sample independent t-test (assume unequal variances).


t.test(Pen_ADG ~ Diet, data = pen_dat)


    Welch Two Sample t-test

data:  Pen_ADG by Diet
t = 0.49128, df = 5.9222, p-value = 0.6409
alternative hypothesis: true difference in means between group 15% (low) and group 30% (high) is not equal to 0
95 percent confidence interval:
 -0.3996644  0.5996644
sample estimates:
 mean in group 15% (low) mean in group 30% (high) 
                   1.415                    1.315 



# t-test code

Report:

Difference in mean ADG

Standard error

t-statistic, degrees of freedom, and p-value



Animal-level analysis

Using turkey_animal_data.csv, conduct the same two-sample independent t-test (assume unequal variances).


t.test(ADG ~ Diet, data = animal_dat)


    Welch Two Sample t-test

data:  ADG by Diet
t = 0.86155, df = 21.823, p-value = 0.3983
alternative hypothesis: true difference in means between group 15% (low) and group 30% (high) is not equal to 0
95 percent confidence interval:
 -0.1408273  0.3408273
sample estimates:
 mean in group 15% (low) mean in group 30% (high) 
                1.408333                 1.308333 



# t-test code

Report:

Difference in mean ADG

Standard error

t-statistic, degrees of freedom, and p-value
